title: Really Need Recursion? Revisiting One-pass Registration with Multi-level Multi-space Contextual Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.22423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deformable image registration is a fundamental challenge in medical image analysis. Recent deep learning-based methods typically adopt either one-pass architectures that complete registration in a single network iteration, or recursive architectures that refine registration through multiple passes. While recursive methods often improve accuracy, they incur substantial computational overhead and slower inference speed. In this paper, we challenge the necessity of recursion for high-performance deformable registration and propose M2CG, a one-pass registration network with Multi-level Multi-space Contextual Guidance. It performs multi-step progressive pyramid registration within a single iteration, guided at each step by contextual cues from three levels (previous, current, and subsequent steps) and four spaces (image space, image feature space, segmentation space, and segmentation feature space). translated_title: 真的需要递归吗？基于多层级多空间上下文引导重新审视一次通过式图像配准
translated_abstract: 可变形图像配准是医学图像分析中的一项基本挑战。近年来基于深度学习的方法通常采用一次通过式架构（在单次网络迭代中完成配准）或递归式架构（通过多次迭代逐步优化配准结果）。尽管递归方法往往能提升配准精度，但会带来巨大的计算开销和较慢的推理速度。在本文中，我们质疑了递归对于高性能可变形配准的必要性，提出了M2CG——一种具有多层级多空间上下文引导的一次通过式配准网络。该方法在单次迭代内执行多步渐进式金字塔配准，且每一步都由来自三个层级（前一步、当前步和后续步）和四个空间（图像空间、图像特征空间、分割空间和分割特征空间）的上下文线索进行引导。我们的M2CG同时支持无监督（……摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 提出了M2CG网络，通过多层级（前步、当前步、后续步）与多空间（图像、图像特征、分割、分割特征）的上下文引导，在单次迭代内完成多步渐进式金字塔配准，无需递归即可实现高精度可变形图像配准并避免递归方法的高计算开销。
en_tdlr: M2CG, a one-pass deformable image registration network that leverages multi-level (previous, current, and subsequent steps) and multi-space (image, image feature, segmentation, and segmentation feature) contextual guidance to achieve progressive pyramid registration within a single iteration, challenging the necessity of recursion while avoiding its substantial computational overhead.
